stemMd: The product of three nonzero real numbers is negative. Which count of negative factors is possible?
explanationMd: A product is negative when it contains an odd number of negative factors. With three nonzero factors, the possibilities are one or three.

distractorRationale.d: No negative factors gives a positive product.
distractorRationale.b: An even number of negative factors gives a positive product.
distractorRationale.a: Three negative factors also give a negative product.
distractorRationale.e: Two negatives multiply to positive, leaving a positive third if exactly two.
